text.tspan: Map the 2D pixels array of the sensor onto the
Canvas Space actualy displayed on the screen.
Given method to draw UI on Canvas according to
Standard pixels on your screen. (0,0) is the top-left of the canvas widget.
The thermal pixels. (0,0) is the top-left of the camera sensor.
Provide a sensor coordinate (e.g., (128,96)) and CoordMapper returns the correct screen coordinate (cx, cy), even when zoomed or resized.
